Role Purpose

VP-Head of Sales is responsible for leading multiple sales teams through Sales Managers to drive segment-level revenue growth, strategic account expansion, and long-term customer value.
This role focuses on defining and executing sales strategies across a portfolio of accounts, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and market opportunities. VP-Head of Sales provides direction and oversight to AVP-Head of Sales or any Account Directors, ensuring consistent execution of account plans, pipeline development, and performance management across teams.
In addition, the role requires strong engagement with senior customer stakeholders, guidance on complex sales opportunities, and oversight of forecasting and business performance. VP-Head of Sales acts as a key link between senior leadership and the sales organization, ensuring strategies are effectively translated into execution and delivering sustainable business growth.

Job Details

Responsibilities:

• Design and develop end-to-end IT solutions for B2B Financial Non Bank clients.
• Translate business needs into functional and technical specifications.
• Identify technological enhancements to drive operational efficiency and customer value.
• Collaborate with the sales team to understand client needs and strategic direction.
• Conduct client meetings to gather requirements and present solution options.
• Provide technical support in client presentations and negotiations.
• Define project scope, objectives, technical requirements, timelines, and budgets.
• Align internal teams and resources based on project milestones.
• Monitor and report project progress against targets.
• Stay current with trends and emerging technologies in supply chain, energy, and digital transformation.
• Proactively recommend innovations and technology applications.
• Drive digital enablement across B2B client solutions.
• Coordinate across IT, product, and operations teams to ensure solution delivery.
• Lead multidisciplinary teams during solution development and implementation.
• Provide coaching and mentoring to solution architects and analysts.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
• Master’s Degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, or relevant field is preferred.
• Minimum 12–15 years of professional experience in IT solution development, enterprise systems, digital infrastructure, ICT, cloud computing, ERP
• At least 5-7 years in a leadership role managing large-scale, cross-functional projects
• Proven experience in designing and implementing technology-driven solutions for B2B clients in the Financial Non Bank sector
• Strong background in working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders
• Strategic thinking and commercial acumen in B2B technology environments.
• Strong project management and budgeting skills.
• Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
• Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, cost-effective technical solutions.
• Leadership, mentoring, and cross-functional team collaboration abilities.
• Adaptability in fast-paced, client-driven environments.
• Proven track record in driving segment/portfolio-level revenue growth
• Strong experience in strategic account management and large-scale deals
• Experience leading large sales organizations or multi-region coverage

Role Purpose

Execute and monitor day-to-day FWA field-sales activity across assigned territories, improving sales-force productivity and completion of valid customer activations.

Scope of Work

1. Daily Field Planning — Assign territories and activity plans to team leaders and AEs based on approved targets.
2. Field Coaching — Conduct joint visits, coaching and daily briefings to improve prospecting and conversion.
3. Lead & Sales Tracking — Monitor lead registration, order quality, follow-up and progress to activation.
4. Team Fulfillment — Track AE staffing, attendance and productivity; coordinate gaps with capability and agency teams.
5. Local Access — Support local permits and relationship-building with area stakeholders.
6. Issue Escalation — Flag device, installation, app or order blockers to accountable operations teams.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Operations or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience. Field sales operations or team supervision experience; requirements scaled to appointed staff/officer level.
• Field execution; customer interaction; mobile sales applications; operational reporting. Strong spreadsheet, presentation and reporting literacy appropriate to the role.
• Ownership and follow-through; clear communication; collaboration across functions; analytical problem-solving; customer and commercial orientation. Leadership and decision complexity should be assessed in proportion to actual role scope.

RINGKASAN PEKERJAAN

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk sedang mencari Henhouse Operator untuk ditempatkan di unit PS PKLN BANTENG-4. Peran ini bertanggung jawab atas operasional harian kandang ayam pembibit (parent stock), guna memastikan kesehatan, kenyamanan, dan produktivitas ayam terjaga dengan optimal sesuai dengan standar operasional prosedur (SOP) perusahaan serta prinsip biosekuriti yang ketat.

TANGGUNG JAWAB PEKERJAAN :

1). Mengawasi dan memastikan pemberian pakan dan air minum untuk ayam berjalan dengan lancar dan sesuai dengan takaran serta jadwal yang ditentukan.
2). Memelihara, membersihkan, dan memastikan kondisi sanitasi kandang serta lingkungan sekitarnya tetap terjaga sesuai dengan standar biosekuriti.
3). Melakukan pemantauan harian terhadap kesehatan dan perilaku ayam, serta segera melaporkan jika ditemukan adanya gejala penyakit atau ketidaknormalan.
4). Mengoperasikan dan merawat peralatan serta sistem otomatisasi di dalam kandang (seperti sistem ventilasi, pemanas, dan pencahayaan) agar berfungsi dengan baik.
5). Membantu proses pengumpulan, penyortiran, dan pencatatan data produksi telur harian.
6). Menerapkan standar Keselamatan dan Kesehatan Kerja (K3) selama menjalankan aktivitas di area peternakan.

KUALIFIKASI PEKERJAAN :
a. Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK (diutamakan jurusan Peternakan, Kesehatan Hewan, atau bidang terkait).
b. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun sebagai Operator Kandang atau di industri peternakan unggas (pengalaman di bagian Parent Stock lebih disukai). Lulusan baru dengan latar belakang pendidikan relevan dipersilakan melamar.
c. Memiliki pemahaman dasar tentang manajemen pemeliharaan ayam, kesehatan unggas, dan prosedur biosekuriti.
d. Disiplin, bertanggung jawab, pekerja keras, dan memiliki ketahanan fisik yang baik untuk bekerja di area kandang.
e. Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun bekerja sama dalam tim.
f. Bersedia ditempatkan di area kerja PS PKLN BANTENG-4 dan tinggal di mess yang disediakan oleh perusahaan (jika diperlukan).
